defects_tracked.description: Campaign Network Graph renders as closely threaded beads / dense hairball without cluster separation, dynamic hub aggregation, or entity search, degrading forensic legibility. Resolved via G-D1..G-D8, deterministic physics, and Gate 21 (ui.graph_legibility).
Synthetic pseudo-entities distort graph topology; aggregation layer collapses and badges synthetic import provenance entities distinctly.
At corpus scale, the campaign graph correlates the top-1,000 emails ordered by threat severity and recency, disclosed explicitly in the UI banner.
Client-side entity search, highlight, and multi-dimensional filter.
Server-side asynchronous 1-hop expansion and refetch querying raw un-correlated database entities beyond active correlation quota.
